title: Quota costs

<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/reference.mjs. Edit scripts/api.config.mjs, then run "npm run reference" in docs/. -->

The numbers come from YouTube's [quota calculator](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/determine_quota_cost) and from the method pages for the ones the calculator leaves out. They are what `yt.quota` counts and what `quotaCost()` returns. [Quota](/basics/quota/) explains how the buckets work and how to spend less.

## Methods with their own bucket

Calls to these are not counted in units of the shared budget. Each has a daily allowance of its own.

| Method | Default allowance | Cost of a call |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `yt.search.list` | 100 calls a day | 1 |
| `yt.videos.batchGetStats` | 10,000 units a day | 1 |
| `yt.videos.insert` | 100 calls a day | 1 |

## Shared budget

Everything else draws from one budget of 10,000 units a day by default.

### 1 unit

`activities.list`, `channelSections.list`, `channels.list`, `commentThreads.list`, `comments.list`, `i18nLanguages.list`, `i18nRegions.list`, `liveBroadcasts.bind`, `liveBroadcasts.delete`, `liveBroadcasts.insert`, `liveBroadcasts.insertCuepoint`, `liveBroadcasts.list`, `liveBroadcasts.transition`, `liveBroadcasts.update`, `liveStreams.delete`, `liveStreams.insert`, `liveStreams.list`, `liveStreams.update`, `members.list`, `membershipsLevels.list`, `playlistImages.list`, `playlistItems.list`, `playlists.list`, `subscriptions.list`, `superChatEvents.list`, `thirdPartyLinks.list`, `videoAbuseReportReasons.list`, `videoCategories.list`, `videoTrainability.get`, `videos.getRating`, `videos.list`

### 5 units

`liveChatMessages.list`, `liveChatMessages.stream`

### 20 units

`liveChatMessages.delete`, `liveChatMessages.insert`, `liveChatMessages.transition`

### 50 units

`abuseReports.insert`, `captions.delete`, `captions.list`, `channelBanners.insert`, `channelSections.delete`, `channelSections.insert`, `channelSections.update`, `channels.update`, `commentThreads.insert`, `comments.delete`, `comments.insert`, `comments.markAsSpam`, `comments.setModerationStatus`, `comments.update`, `liveChatModerators.list`, `playlistImages.delete`, `playlistImages.insert`, `playlistImages.update`, `playlistItems.delete`, `playlistItems.insert`, `playlistItems.update`, `playlists.delete`, `playlists.insert`, `playlists.update`, `subscriptions.delete`, `subscriptions.insert`, `thirdPartyLinks.delete`, `thirdPartyLinks.insert`, `thirdPartyLinks.update`, `thumbnails.set`, `videos.delete`, `videos.rate`, `videos.reportAbuse`, `videos.update`, `watermarks.set`, `watermarks.unset`

### 200 units

`captions.download`, `liveChatBans.delete`, `liveChatBans.insert`, `liveChatModerators.delete`, `liveChatModerators.insert`

### 400 units

`captions.insert`

### 450 units

`captions.update`

## Analytics and Reporting

The Analytics and Reporting APIs are not billed in units. They have request rate limits of their own, visible in the Google Cloud console. `yt.quota.usage` counts their calls under `analytics` and `reporting` for information.
